inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev28 TXIF graph synchronization, dev27 scene graph, dev26 mesh graph, dev25 retail GMX evidence, native builders, mod packages, extraction/research and source-only gates are inherited. 2.9.0-dev1 opens a new minor feature line and integrates GMX/TXIF import with TEX/BBX mod staging.

proven_regression: edited glTF compiles through mesh/scene/TXIF synchronization
linked PNG rebuilds to native TEX through a compatible donor layout
new TXIF name can append a new named BBX member
BBX count/name/hash tables rebuild and reparse
.siigmod packages the entry-count change as a baseline-dependent archive delta and reconstructs the exact target in a fresh workspace
mod_gltf_texture_pipeline.inherited_external_retail_gate: dev25 306/306 mesh-bearing retail GMX no-op byte-identical plus plr_001 topology smoke

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 75/75 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: New TEX payloads still require a compatible native donor layout; arbitrary TEX header/layout synthesis is not implemented.
Arbitrary GMX vertex declarations and MTRL parameter schemas remain donor-dependent.
MOTN/ANIM graph synthesis/import, platform shader compilation, and fully template-free GMX creation remain unresolved.
BBX member addition is structurally regression-tested; retail runtime acceptance of arbitrary newly appended texture members remains to be proven on hardware/emulator.
The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX evidence is inherited rather than re-run from proprietary inputs.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
